2607.17973.title: SAGE: Subgoal-Conditioned Action Generation for Latent World Model Planning
2607.17973.paper_summary: Latent world models have emerged as a powerful planning paradigm by learning action-conditioned predictive dynamics and using them as internal simulators to imagine and evaluate candidate action sequences. However, as the planning horizon grows, performance becomes increasingly constrained by proposal quality: a fixed candidate budget must search an exponentially larger action space, making it difficult to expose the world model to high-quality candidate futures for evaluation. In this paper, we introduce a prior-conditioned planner that replaces random proposal initialization with structured guidance. At each planning stage, a goal-conditioned generator predicts the next reachable latent subgoal for a specified duration, which is then used to condition the generation of candidate action sequences. To capture semantic information across temporal scales, we use subgoals of varying durations as priors, balancing fine-grained local control with higher-level long-horizon progress. Then the frozen world model evaluates and refines these subgoal-conditioned proposals before execution. Experiments on PushT and OGBench Cube show that coupling latent subgoal decomposition with prior-conditioned action generation substantially improves long-horizon planning while preserving strong short-horizon performance. To be specific, when the target offset is $150$, it raises PushT success from $12.7\%$ to $64.7\%$ and OGBench Cube success from $26.7\%$ to $67.3\%$.
2607.17973.paper_summary_zh: 潛在世界模型已成為一種強大的規劃範式，通過學習行動條件的預測動力學，並將其用作內部模擬器來想像和評估候選行動序列。然而，隨著規劃視野的增長，性能越來越受到提案質量的限制：固定的候選預算必須在指數增長的行動空間中進行搜索，使得難以將世界模型暴露於高質量的候選未來以進行評估。在本文中，我們介紹了一種先驗條件規劃器，通過結構化指導來取代隨機提案初始化。在每個規劃階段，目標條件生成器預測在指定時間內可達的下一個潛在子目標，然後用於條件生成候選行動序列。為了捕捉跨時間尺度的語義信息，我們使用不同持續時間的子目標作為先驗，平衡細粒度的局部控制與更高層次的長期進展。然後，凍結的世界模型在執行之前評估和完善這些子目標條件的提案。在PushT和OGBench Cube上的實驗顯示，將潛在子目標分解與先驗條件的行動生成相結合，顯著改善了長期規劃，同時保持強大的短期性能。具體而言，當目標偏移量為$150$時，PushT的成功率從$12.7\%$提高到$64.7\%$，OGBench Cube的成功率從$26.7\%$提高到$67.3\%$。
